SHAR Production

Production Readiness Scorecards

Quantitative readiness tools with transparent weights and deterministic decisions.

brief-readiness

Brief readiness

Measures whether objectives, audience, deliverables and constraints are ready for production.

rights-readiness

Rights readiness

Measures documented usage rights, territories, terms and attribution obligations.

budget-readiness

Budget readiness

Measures estimate coverage, contingencies, approvals and cost traceability.

schedule-readiness

Schedule readiness

Measures dependencies, milestones, buffers and accountable owners.

location-readiness

Location readiness

Measures access, permits, utilities, restrictions and fallback plans.

talent-readiness

Talent readiness

Measures availability, consent, usage terms, travel and welfare readiness.

crew-readiness

Crew readiness

Measures role coverage, contacts, rest, safety and escalation paths.

safety-readiness

Safety readiness

Measures hazards, controls, briefings, medical response and incident ownership.

camera-readiness

Camera readiness

Measures capture settings, media capacity, monitoring, reports and redundancy.

sound-readiness

Sound readiness

Measures channel plans, synchronization, monitoring, reports and backups.

dit-readiness

DIT readiness

Measures checksum policy, copies, naming, reports and handoff evidence.

editorial-readiness

Editorial readiness

Measures source inventory, proxies, sync, project structure and decision ownership.

vfx-readiness

VFX readiness

Measures shot scope, pulls, handles, color context and review ownership.

color-readiness

Color readiness

Measures color pipeline, references, conform, monitoring and approval evidence.

mix-readiness

Mix readiness

Measures stems, channel maps, loudness targets, references and approval evidence.

caption-readiness

Caption readiness

Measures timing, reading speed, speaker cues, locale rules and QC evidence.

accessibility-readiness

Accessibility readiness

Measures captions, audio description, contrast, controls and review evidence.

localization-readiness

Localization readiness

Measures locale coverage, terminology, assets, approvals and fallback behavior.

platform-readiness

Platform readiness

Measures format profiles, metadata, naming, QC and delivery receipts.

archive-readiness

Archive readiness

Measures inventory, fixity, copy diversity, restore tests and retention ownership.

provenance-readiness

Provenance readiness

Measures source lineage, AI/CGI disclosure, licenses, edits and evidence links.

privacy-readiness

Privacy readiness

Measures minimization, access control, retention, redaction and incident response.

supplier-readiness

Supplier readiness

Measures identity, scope, pricing, rights, delivery and escalation commitments.

sustainability-readiness

Sustainability readiness

Measures travel, energy, waste, materials, measurement and accountable actions.

release-readiness

Release readiness

Measures approvals, technical QC, rights, accessibility, delivery and rollback evidence.
